lines.zh: 我走过的地方，火星一颗颗掉。
lines.en: Sparks drop from me as I walk.
I tread the cinders and my feet glow red.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，火星拖出一条线。
lines.en: I shuffle, and the sparks trail a line.

lines.zh: 我经过的木梁开始冒烟。
lines.en: The beams I pass begin to smoke.
I walk slowly; the fire doesn't.
I brush the grass and it scorches.

lines.zh: 我钻到屋檐下，那里更暗。
lines.en: I duck under the eaves, where it's darker.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸带出一串噼啪声。
lines.en: My breath crackles as it comes.

lines.zh: 我一边走，火星一边往前滚。
lines.en: As I walk, sparks roll ahead of me.
I raise a hand; my fingertips burn.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，墙上留了黑印。
lines.en: I walk the wall and leave black marks.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让火星落干净。
lines.en: I stop and let the sparks fall away.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的火星在跳。
lines.en: I stand, sparks dancing on me.

lines.zh: 屋檐下有块阴影，我待着。
lines.en: I keep to the shade under the eaves.

lines.zh: 我数着火星炸开的声音。
lines.en: I count the sparks popping.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤像烧过的木头。
lines.en: My skin is like burnt wood.
I pinch a spark out.
The wind carries sparks farther.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地吸气，喉咙发亮。
lines.en: I breathe in slowly and my throat glows.
No water here. Good.
I don't move, but I'm burning.

lines.zh: 我想起自己是怎么死的。
lines.en: I remember how I died.
You're sweating. You'll catch fire.
Don't touch the sparks on me.

lines.zh: 屋檐下的火星正往你脚边走。
lines.en: The sparks under the eaves are creeping toward your feet.
Three paces from you. Just right.
I was burning when I died too.
This roof cuts the light. I like it.
Your boots will burn first.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，火星往外蹦。
lines.en: When I laugh, sparks jump out.
Do you smell it? Burning.

lines.zh: 我等着你踏进这片屋檐。
lines.en: I wait for you to step under these eaves.
My sparks are scattered.
I dropped some coals; it hurts.
That snuffed out half of me.
I retreat, and the sparks retreat too.
My throat dims.
I press to the wall, breathing heat.
Something crackles. It's me.
You knocked my sparks everywhere.
I can still burn. Don't leave yet.
I've kept that blow among my sparks.
That flame comforts me.
The smell of dry hay is best.
Give me the torch in your hand.

lines.zh: 靠近热的东西，我就不冷。
lines.en: Near heat, I'm not cold.

lines.zh: 木头的味道，我想蹭一蹭。
lines.en: Woodsmoke; I want to rub against it.
I drift toward that woodpile.
A dry place. How rare.
I reach out only for warmth.
Building a fire? Let me help.
My sparks are drifting toward you.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，袖子焦了一块。
lines.en: You hit me and your sleeve scorches.
I step back so I don't burn you.
We collide and sparks spray.
Don't push; I'm all fire.
You're against me, and your clothes smoke.

lines.zh: 我侧身让，火星落了一地。
lines.en: I turn aside, and sparks fall.
That knock shook loose some coals.
You step on a spark and jump.

lines.zh: 我扶住墙，墙上留了手印。
lines.en: I brace on the wall and leave a handprint.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近了，会烧起来。
lines.en: We're too close; something will catch.
Another ordure drifts near.

lines.zh: 我们贴近，火星合成一片。
lines.en: We come close and our sparks merge.
Its fire is brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起把木梁点着了。
lines.en: Together we set the beam alight.
Two fires dance under the eaves.

lines.zh: 它把一颗火星按进我掌心。
lines.en: It presses a spark into my palm.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只听噼啪响。
lines.en: We say nothing, only listen to the crackle.

lines.zh: 它会在我烧完时接着烧。
lines.en: It will keep burning when I'm done.

lines.zh: 我们一起数着还有多久。
lines.en: Together we count how much time is left.
Smoke wraps us both.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块炭，攥在手里。
lines.en: I pick up a coal and close my fist.
This wood; I'll burn it.
I tuck it into my chest.
It scorches the moment it touches me.
A spark on the ground; that's mine.
I pick it up, sniff, and it's burnt.
This will make good kindling.
I hold it, and it slowly blackens.
It's mine. Stay back.

lines.zh: 这块木头会烧，我夹在腋下。
lines.en: This wood will burn; I tuck it under my arm.
You smell flammable.

lines.zh: 火星落在我身上，烧得更旺。
lines.en: The sparks land on me and burn brighter.
Sparks begin dancing at your feet.
My throat is glowing.
Under this roof you won't get far.

lines.zh: 一串噼啪火星从屋顶落下来。
lines.en: A crackling string of sparks falls from the roof.
Retreat, and the sparks follow.
I'm very hot. You'll find out.
The air is growing hot.
This will leave a scar.
I've waited until now.
The hem of your coat is curling.
I count to three; the sparks burst.
Don't look at me with your eyes.
The wooden wall behind you is very dry.
Let's begin now.
I close in, step by step.
The sparks arrive first; I follow.

lines.zh: 你跑过的地方，草在冒烟。
lines.en: Grass smokes where you run.
I'm waiting for you to hit dry grass.
The heat shoves the air aside.

lines.zh: 我身上噼啪响，越来越密。
lines.en: My crackling grows denser.
You've backed to the wooden door. Good.
All these eaves are mine.
I'm not quick, but fire climbs.
Your breathing grows shallower.
Wait. It's almost time.
When I stop, I burst.

lines.zh: 火星在你背后聚成一团。
lines.en: Sparks gather behind you.
I hear cloth rustle.
Smoke rises from the floorboards' seams.
Three more steps is enough.
Don't waste the water in your hand.

lines.zh: 我烧起来的时候，会很大声。
lines.en: When I go up, it'll be loud.

lines.zh: 这里的每块木头都认得我。
lines.en: Every plank here knows me.

lines.zh: 火星聚在你脚边，越来越密。
lines.en: Sparks gather at your feet, denser and denser.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，火星炸开。
lines.en: My palm comes down and sparks burst.
A scorch mark on your arm.
I press close and burn you back.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，布烧起来了。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and it catches.
This one comes with fire. It's hot.
You roll once on the ground.
I throw all my sparks at once.

lines.zh: 你退了三大步，还在冒烟。
lines.en: You back three paces, still smoking.
I hear you suck in a breath.
I grip your collar; it's hot.
Struggle more and it burns faster.

lines.zh: 我的手印留在你的胸口。
lines.en: My handprint stays on your chest.
I let go, and only then do you breathe.
Sparks splash on your boots.
You stagger into the wall.
I'm very hot now.

lines.zh: 我的手掌烫穿了你的护腕。
lines.en: My palm burns through your bracer.

lines.zh: 火星顺你的领口钻进去。
lines.en: Sparks slip down your collar.
You raise a hand to block, and it blisters.
I drive you to the edge of the woodpile.
It suddenly brightens under the eaves.

lines.zh: 一颗火星落在地上，滚了滚。
lines.en: A spark lands and rolls.

lines.zh: 我从焦黑的木头里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the charred wood.
A burnt smell fills the air.
A black ring burns into the floor.

lines.zh: 屋顶的阴影里多了个人形。
lines.en: A shape joins the roof's shadow.
Someone coughs. It's me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地站直，火星往下掉。
lines.en: I straighten slowly, sparks falling.
This room is starting to heat.

lines.zh: 我从一堆炭灰里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a heap of cinders.
When I look up, the eaves seem lower.
I arrive, and sparks come with me.
Fire only makes me burn brighter.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，火星撒了一地。
lines.en: I fall and sparks scatter over the floor.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，噼啪一声，暗了。
lines.en: Water hits me with a hiss, and I dim.

lines.zh: 有顶的地方，我都能冒出来。
lines.en: Anywhere with a roof, I can rise.
A string of sparks spits out of the arrow hole.
That spell freezes my sparks in midair.

lines.zh: 没有东西可烧，我快熄了。
lines.en: Nothing to burn; I'm going out.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整团火都炸开了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my whole fire bursts.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的火一粒粒吸走。
lines.en: The void draws off my fire spark by spark.
